Weather

Usually a crosswind You ride ESE; early-September wind here runs from the WSW at 6.4 mph, though it only holds that direction 62% of the time. Mean of 2015–2024 September, 9:00–17:00, at the day’s midpoint. What to expect, not a forecast.

The day at a glance

The first hour crosses the Oxnard Plain, among the most productive vegetable and strawberry ground in the United States and still farmed hard right up to the edge of the city. After Point Mugu the farming stops and the rest of the day is the Malibu coast.

Worth looking up for

  • Final day down the coast through Ventura and Malibu into Santa Monica.
  • One of the two easiest days for climbing, at 1,661 ft.

What to watch for

  • Pacific Coast Highway traffic is heavy and fast, especially through Malibu on a Saturday. Be prepared to ride two-by-two, take the lane, and stay together.
  • Only real climb is mi 38.6–39.3, 185 ft at 5.1%.

Stops along the way

Mapped in OpenStreetMap and carried in the GPX as waypoints, so they show on a head unit too. Distances are miles from the start. Tap a name for Google Maps, or the arrow for Apple Maps. Not verified on the ground — opening hours and whether a tap actually runs are anyone’s guess. A star marks a stop somebody picked by hand and vouched for, rather than one the OpenStreetMap query happened to return. Everything else here is within a quarter mile of the line; the few that are further say how far.
